in_marathi.name: Birva

in_marathi.long_meaning: Birva हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Birva is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'bir', which means 'God'. This name is associated with the deity of agriculture and fertility, often invoked for prosperity and abundance. In Hindu mythology, Birva is a manifestation of Lord Vishnu, symbolizing the power of creation and nourishment.
